messages:
Sofia Martins: Quick sync — proposing a joint performance pilot with ThermalWave next week. Primary goals: optimize perf/W, validate sustained throughput at 3k tokens/s on 16k context, and lock down a small announcement playbook. Luke from TW is on this thread.
Raj Patel: +1. Need to confirm measurement surface: p95 latency, avg throughput, power draw (W) at rack-level and per-GPU. Also kernel flags and quant paths.
Luke - ThermalWave: Happy to join. We can provide chassis telemetry, per-board power sensors, and our kernel engineers. Baseline on our side: 2.1k toks/s @ 16k with stock kernel, ~310W system draw (measured at PDU).
Emily Chen: Marketing want 1-2 hero graphs: perf/W curve and a normalized throughput chart vs our hosted model. We should agree on messaging guardrails before running public numbers.
Sofia Martins: Agreed. Let's keep any public claims to relative improvements and link to detailed runbook. Also need to coordinate marketplace listing copy so it's ready if we do a joint announcement.
Raj Patel: Can we do an initial dry-run focusing on kernel-level tweaks only (no model changes) to get uplift numbers? If so, I can own the kernel tuning plan.
Luke - ThermalWave: Dry-run okay. Our engineers can run preliminary tests Fri morning PT. Who's driving the orchestration?
Sofia Martins: Raj + Luke on the technical side, Emily on comms, I'll handle partner ops and legal checklist. Infra-bot, can you schedule a dry-run slot for Fri 09:00 PT and tag the infra oncall?
infra-bot: bench-scheduler: Dry-run reserved: 2026-04-03 09:00 PT. Notifying #eng-infra oncall.
Raj Patel: Thanks. Prep steps: 1) baseline capture (no patches), 2) microkernel patch A (loop unroll + fused-attn), 3) patch B (KV cache reorder), 4) measure perf/W and thermal headroom.
Sofia Martins: Add a step for safety: record any regression in output tokens and do a small eval with 100 prompts to ensure no quality regressions.
Luke - ThermalWave: We'll provide PDU logs and per-GPU sensors. Quick question: do you want raw telemetry or aggregated CSVs?
Raj Patel: Raw preferred (timestamped). Give us CSV+parquet if possible. We'll run our analysis scripts.
Emily Chen: Draft timeline for announcement: 1) dry-run (this Fri), 2) tuned runs + verification (next week), 3) internal review + partner sign-off, 4) press/social + marketplace update. Target soft announcement in 2 weeks if data looks good.
Sofia Martins: Legal: please don't commit to any SLA numbers in drafts. We'll use "validated in collaboration" language.
Raj Patel: Quick config snippet I'll test first pass (sharing inline):
```bash
# kernel quick flags
export RW_KERN_TUNE=1
./bench_runner --model redwood-curie --seq 16384 --batch 1 --quant q4_0 --kern-patch A
```
Luke - ThermalWave: That looks fine. We'll mirror that on our infra and compare. We'll also run a longer 2-hour stability test after tuning.
Sofia Martins: Action items: Raj to post kernel patch PR and run results; Luke to upload baseline telemetry; Emily to draft joint announcement language; Sofia to circulate partner ops checklist and legal contact. Check-in thread for results: please post summaries here.
Emily Chen: I'll draft the announcement bullet points and share in a doc by EOD Thu.
Raj Patel: I'll push initial patch branch and upload a short CSV of baseline numbers by Thu night.
Luke - ThermalWave: I'll confirm hardware engineers on Fri and upload PDU logs to the shared bucket before the run.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder: ensure bench cluster has kernel debug symbols enabled for the tune run.
Sofia Martins: Thanks everyone. If we see >=15% perf/W uplift with no quality regressions, we can move to joint case study. Keep comms scoped and EMG in the loop. :rocket:
